questions.question: Which financial statement reports the financial performance over a specific period of time?

options.label: B
options.text: Statement of Profit or Loss (Income Statement)

questions.correct_answer_text: Statement of Profit or Loss (Income Statement)
questions.explanation: The income statement summarizes revenues and expenses incurred over an accounting period to report net profit or loss.

questions.question: Gross Profit is calculated as:

options.label: B
options.text: Net Sales - Cost of Goods Sold

questions.correct_answer_text: Net Sales - Cost of Goods Sold
questions.explanation: Gross profit equals net sales revenue minus the direct cost of goods sold (COGS).

questions.question: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) in a trading business is computed by:

options.label: A
options.text: Opening Inventory + Net Purchases + Direct Expenses - Closing Inventory

options.label: B
options.text: Opening Inventory + Closing Inventory - Net Purchases

questions.correct_answer_text: Opening Inventory + Net Purchases + Direct Expenses - Closing Inventory
questions.explanation: COGS = Opening Stock + Net Purchases + Direct Expenses - Closing Stock.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered an intangible fixed asset?
questions.explanation: Goodwill, patents, trademarks, and copyrights are intangible assets that lack physical substance.

questions.question: Outstanding salary at the end of the year is presented in the Balance Sheet as a:
questions.explanation: Salaries that are due but not yet paid represent a current obligation (liability) of the business.
